title: Thread
logline: A weaver turns thread into cloth, and at some point during the work the thread stops being thread and starts being a thing with a name and a price.
human_question: At what moment does a pile of thread become 'a cloth', and where does 'the cloth' go when it is taken apart?

situation.what_happens: One piece of cloth is made from beginning to end, on a loom that sets the pace of a household's day. It starts as spools with a cost, becomes warp and weft, and slowly becomes a thing people describe by its pattern rather than by its material. At some point in that process everybody, including the weaver, starts calling it by a name. Elsewhere in the same household, old cloth is going the other way: unpicked, cut down, reused as something else, until there is only thread again.
situation.who_is_involved: A weaver whose income depends on finishing; whoever else in the household prepares thread, dyes or sells; and the buyer who ordered the piece and has an opinion about what it should look like.
situation.what_is_at_stake: A commission, a price and a deadline, in a trade where the margin is thin and the work is slow. For the weaver, whether this kind of work can still support a household at all.
situation.how_it_unfolds: It begins with an order and a quantity of thread, and proceeds at the loom's speed, which cannot be hurried. The pressures are the cost of yarn, the buyer's expectations, eyesight, hands and the hours a body can work. It ends when the piece is finished and handed over, or when it is not, or when the buyer rejects it. Reality decides.

concept_merge.why_together: C084 supplies the sources' own example, exactly: divide a thing, and if what seemed present disappears, as cloth disappears into thread, then it was a concept and not an ultimate [C084-M:L7]. C077 supplies the direction the method is eventually pointed in, the same taking-apart applied to a person in order to loosen 'I' and 'mine' [C077-M:L24]. A loom is the one place where the example can be watched running forwards and backwards in the same room.
concept_merge.what_it_reveals: That the division test has a moment in it. Something becomes a named whole at a particular point in a week's work, and the weaver can usually say when, which makes the concept a thing with a history rather than a category.

concept_links.why: The Margaya's own division test, given in these very terms: cloth pulled apart is thread, so cloth is a concept and thread the more basic reality [C084-M:L7], and the finished piece is a collective concept named for an arrangement. The digest's limit applies: conventional wholes are valid in their own domain, and the point is not that the cloth is unreal.

The compendium's method of gathering a whole into its parts is taught for a purpose, to loosen the sense of 'I' and 'mine' [C077-M:L24; C077-P:L996–L1010], and this idea is the mildest possible rehearsal of it, performed on a piece of cloth rather than on anybody.

what_the_viewer_could_understand: That a whole can appear from parts and vanish back into them, and that the name belongs to the arrangement rather than to the material, which is as true of a cloth as of anything else people give names to.
what_must_be_real: The weaver's real work, real orders and real economics. No piece is started, finished or unpicked for the camera.
position_hint: middle; its substance now sits inside IDEA-0005, where the same test is carried by a repair a family's income depends on.
risks: A craft showcase with no stake for the person doing the work.
Being a visual copy of a textbook example rather than a portrait of a trade.
drop_if: No weaver with a real commission during the window.
The only way to see a piece completed is to commission one for the film.

connections.note: Its division test and its question about the moment of naming now carry the boat film's doctrinal spine.

selection.reason: Its cloth-and-thread test is the exact repair IDEA-0005 needed, so its substance was folded there rather than run as a second film about parts and wholes.

unknowns: No participant or event has been found or confirmed. Everything here is a research direction.
evidence_class_note: Editorial proposal. No location, scene or shot decisions are made at the idea stage.
